ce_bugs.text: members endpoint no longer bounds limit parameter, so ?limit=1000000 can serialize the entire membership of a huge group in one request

Pagination off-by-one: 'next' clamps offset to user_count and totalPages uses floor(count/limit)+1, producing partially filled or empty last page (e.g., count=100, limit=50 gives 3 pages with empty page 3), causing a wasted request and UI confusion
Unbounded usernames payload accepted server-side in add_members with no cap on number of usernames, making the N+1 worst-case unbounded
Default 200-member page size for automatic groups removed; every group now defaults to limit=50, silently truncating membership lists
Frontend group members template iterates `members` which is never set on the members controller, rendering an empty list
Public members endpoint has no upper cap on limit parameter, allowing unbounded serialization of large group memberships (DoS vector)
Negative or huge offsets are also unvalidated on the members endpoint
totalPages off-by-one: floor(user_count/limit)+1 reports an extra page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so showingLast is never true and next navigates to an empty page
add_members does not strip whitespace when splitting usernames, so 'user1, user2' silently fails to find user2, and there is no test covering this
Off-by-one in totalPages calculation: exact multiples of limit produce wrong page count, so showingLast never true and next fetches empty offset
findMembers returns undefined instead of resolved promise when name is empty, breaking contract for future .then() callers
Pagination math over-counts totalPages when user_count % limit == 0, showing an empty last page
next() clamps offset with Math.min(offset + limit, user_count), producing a phantom page showing zero members while claiming a valid page
findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise when group name is empty, breaking .then() chaining for callers
Public members endpoint has no cap on limit/offset params, allowing DoS via limit=100000000 and unvalidated offset (negatives/huge values)
group-members template binds members but controller model is now the Group; if controller is an ArrayController, members list renders empty silently
Stale user_count is used to clamp offset in findMembers before the AJAX call, causing pagination to land past the end or show stale count

mrv_findings.text: `{{#unless automatic}}` in group_member.hbs is evaluated in the item-view context where `automatic` is undefined, so the remove link renders for automatic group members and the DELETE fails with a 422 can_not_modify_automatic error
totalPages calculation `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` has an off-by-one error when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, causing the 'next' button to lead to an empty members page

findMembers' empty-name branch changed from returning `Ember.RSVP.resolve([])` to a bare `return;`, breaking the thenable contract and causing TypeError for any caller chaining `.then()` on the result
GroupMembersController never sets `members`, so the public `/groups/:name/members` template iterates over nothing and renders an empty table
Public members page has no pagination controls while `groups_controller.rb#members` caps results at 50, silently hiding members past the first 50
`add_members` in admin groups controller silently skips nonexistent usernames and returns success_json, giving admins no feedback for misspelled usernames
`totalPages` calculation `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` is wrong when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, producing a phantom empty page
`findMembers` offset is clamped against stale `user_count` and the server does not clamp offset to total, so removing a member on the last page leaves currentPage beyond totalPages showing e.g. "5/4"
`remove_member` doesn't validate that user_id is a member and returns success_json without verifying the join row was actually deleted
`addMembers` in admin-group.js.es6 never clears the input after a successful add and has no error handling on the returned promise

No spec coverage for the public `members` endpoint's pagination contract (meta: total/limit/offset), and `params[:limit]` of 0 or negative is passed straight to `.limit(0)`, returning no members with total > 0
Controller spec uses xhr :put :remove_member but the route defined is a DELETE route, so the tests will raise an unrecognized-route error and never exercise the action
Shared form styling block in admin_base.scss includes .badges selector unrelated to the stated intent of group membership handling

New update action in admin/groups_controller.rb drops support for membership changes via PUT /admin/groups/:id, silently breaking existing API callers with no test asserting the breakage or deprecation
findMembers in group.js no longer returns a promise for nameless/new groups (returns undefined instead of Ember.RSVP.resolve([])), breaking the promise-returning invariant
Unversioned breaking API change: groups members endpoint response shape changed from bare array to object with members/meta envelope, breaking existing consumers
Route removed: GET /admin/groups/:group_id/users deleted with no replacement or deprecation, causing 404s for existing clients
PATCH-based incremental membership API (update_patch handling changes add/delete) deleted with no replacement, so memberships can no longer be modified via PUT /admin/groups/:id

add_members silently drops unknown usernames and reports success even when zero members were added, with input not cleared so failure is invisible; the spec covering silent failure was deleted rather than replaced with error reporting
group.findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise when name is empty, breaking callers that chain .then()
Pagination off-by-one: totalPages and currentPage calculations are wrong when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, showing an extra empty page
After deleting the last member of the last page, findMembers clamps offset using stale pre-deletion user_count, resulting in an empty page
params[:limit] is uncapped client input on a public route, allowing expensive full-list materialization queries (no MAX_LIMIT clamp)
N+1 query: User.find_by_username called in a loop for each username in add_members
remove_member relies on group.users.delete(user_id) plus group.save side effects; save returns true regardless of whether the delete matched, so no real invariant is checked
update action accepts params[:name] without stripping whitespace, diverging from the create path's validation for the same column

asJSON() no longer includes usernames and server update/create no longer read params[:group][:usernames], silently dropping membership changes from API consumers and making one-step group creation with members impossible
Public group members page defaults to limit=50 with no pagination controls, so groups with more than 50 members silently show only the first 50 to regular users
group_member.hbs references 'automatic' which is undefined on the User item context, so the remove link always renders even for automatic groups
removeMember has no error handler, so when the server rejects removal from an automatic group with 422 can_not_modify_automatic, the member stays listed with no feedback
alias_level and visible are applied unconditionally to automatic groups in the new update controller, loosening the automatic-group non-modifiable protection invariant while name is still guarded

Unvalidated limit/offset on public members endpoint (groups_controller.rb:22-24): no upper bound or sign check allows limit=100000000 causing server to serialize entire membership of any visible group in one response
Negative limit value passed straight into AR's limit() with undefined behavior
group.users.count plus the query run twice amplifies the cost of the over-fetch
usernames.split(",") on a possibly-array param causes a 500 error path
spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:~92 uses xhr :put, :remove_member against a delete route (test-quality issue)

Test for 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' uses PUT instead of DELETE for remove_member route, so it raises UrlGenerationError or hits add_members and never exercises the can_not_modify_automatic branch or verifies the 422 status

New add_members action silently skips unknown usernames, but the tests pinning this behavior ('succeeds silently when adding non-existent users' / 'removing non-members') were deleted rather than ported, leaving the silent-skip branch with zero coverage

The rewritten update action's non-automatic branch (accepting flat params[:name], dropping usernames, alias_level handling) is untested — no test renames a non-automatic group or verifies old nested-param callers' breakage
No test for the add_members error path (render_json_error) or for group.save failing after adds; the entire failure branch is untested dead code as both tests only assert be_success

The public GroupsController#members rewrite (pagination limit/offset and new meta envelope) has no spec coverage, even though the frontend findMembers hard-depends on result.meta.total/limit/offset — contract drift could cause NaN pagination in the admin UI undetected

Public group members endpoint /groups/:group_id/users removed and response shape changed from bare array to {members: [...], meta: {...}} with no deprecation window, breaking existing consumers during rolling deploys

Rewritten admin groups update action silently drops membership changes: old clients sending PUT group[usernames] or PATCH changes payloads get a success response while membership changes are not applied
Atomic cutover of frontend group save (asJSON no longer includes usernames) with new member endpoints means mixed-version deploys can silently lose group membership edits with a 200 response
remove_member uses group.users.delete(user_id) instead of destroying the GroupUser record, skipping callbacks/side effects that the add path triggers, causing data drift
